description: Read-only YouTube Analytics (views, watch-time, likes, subscribers, etc.) via the API — needs the YouTube API configured/authorized in Settings → YouTube. Channel-wide or per-video.

channelId.description: Channel id (UC…). Defaults to the configured/owning channel.

metrics.description: Metrics, e.g. ["views","estimatedMinutesWatched","likes","subscribersGained"]. Sensible defaults if omitted.

videoId.description: Limit the report to one video. Omit for channel-wide.

name: youtube_analytics
